summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), and test/test_extras/test_shacl.py with a parametrized valid/invalid test, a non-node input test, and a test that the graph is unchanged after parsing. Tests pass: test/test_extras and test/test_path.py gave 119 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed. Nothing was committed. Not verified: black, isort, and mypy are not in the shared venv, so formatting was checked by hand (line lengths via awk) and the type-ignore placements have not been confirmed by a type checker. Choices made: non-node inputs are rejected via the Node type check because BNode is not on the allowed import list; modifiers are three explicit branches so each has its own predicate comment.
